system.description:
The target gains [Cancel (Non-Close Attacks): 10]. This [Cancel] is removed after applying once. This skill's [Hate] cost is equal to [Number of Targets].

(CR8): Increase the [Cancel] rating to 20.
(CR15): Increase the [Cancel] rating to 30.
(CR22): Increase the [Cancel] rating to 40.
(CR29): Increase the [Cancel] rating to 50.

A special skill that creates a force field that protects the target by playing a melody with liberation and blessings. The repeated melody creates a wind current that deflects attacks.
